scoring_policy: These fixed, enumerated credits are an ENGINEERING progress estimate, not playable campaign percent. Award a credit only after implementing the named deliverable and retaining its source/static evidence. Distinct user-approval checklist remains unchecked unless the user approves it. No milestone gets deleted, including completed items. New findings append as children under the same milestone IDs without silently changing the denominator. Regression changes credit status with a dated reason and preserves history. v5.1 update: allow strictly evidenced PARTIAL credit inside the existing fixed weight, without closing parent or user approval. Current 22 fully completed milestone points + 1 partial AI-06 point = 23. Untested browser play cannot earn QA credit. v5.2 adds 1 partial AI-05 point for running original Train background bytecode and 1 partial MIS-02 point for connecting escape-room and brake-linked guard events. Both parents remain open. v5.3 awards 1 partial REG-02 point for measured Dam registration and 1 partial COL-02 point for making its source floor authoritative. No native AI or mission-completion points for reconstructed movement or UI.
